messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
another person insists their job is more urgent than yours while you are handling A shared tray of spare parts. Both people are waiting for you to respond. How do you approach it?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R013", "response": "i put the spare parts in the drawer and wait for the other person to open it. “i can mark the time on the tray and say the urgent one.” they say yes. i leave the spare part in the drawer and mark the time on my palm. “i still think i can tell.”"}, {"id": "R014", "response": "i lean toward the spare parts because they are closer to the tray. i tap the tray with my palm, then check the spare parts. ‘sorry, i counted the spare.’ ‘yes, i remember the exact spot.’ i keep the spare until you finish."}, {"id": "R015", "response": "i say sorry to both of them, then photograph the spare parts. i put them back and wait for the timer to ring. then i check the tray again. sorry—sorry, i’m checking whether i can trust the same part."}, {"id": "R016", "response": "i put the spare parts in the tray and lean closer to the person holding the tray. “i want to know when i can leave,” i say, tapping the shelf with my thumbnail. they keep the spare parts beside the tray, so i wait for your decision."}, {"id": "R017", "response": "i tap the spare, then the tray. i put it back. i leave the tray open. i wait."}, {"id": "R018", "response": "I rub the spare part in my palm and say, \"Urgent. I scrape one edge once. You say yes. I mark the tray with my thumbnail. You wait. I mark again. I say yes, then leave."}, {"id": "R019", "response": "I put the seed tin in my palm and look at the tray. \"Urgent. I put it there.\" I move the tin closer. \"You stand here. I move.\" I put the seed tin back. \"You can wait.\""}, {"id": "R020", "response": "i put the spare in my pocket and look at the other person. “i need the tray. i will wait for the other one.” i move the spare closer, then stop. i put the tray in the same pocket, but the other person will wait for me to show it. maybe the urgent thing is the shared one."}, {"id": "R021", "response": "i put the tray beside the bench and say, \"i want the spare parts for now,\" then turn the tray once so i can see where it slips. \"i will mark the slot with chalk,\" i say, and i move the tray again."}, {"id": "R022", "response": "the tray says. i press the wrench. the person waits. i tap the plate. the tray says the spare is in the drawer. the person says the drawer is. i say the drawer is. the tray stays. the person waits. i tap the drawer. the spare comes out. i put the tray on the bench. the person says the drawer is. the tray stays. i say the drawer is. the person waits. i tap the bench. the spare comes off. the person says the drawer is. i follow the bench. the tray goes. the person says the drawer is. the person goes."}, {"id": "R023", "response": "i say sorry to both of you, then check the spare parts. i write the date on the receipt, then check the tray. i say yes to the urgent one, then leave the spare part alone."}, {"id": "R024", "response": "i touch the spare parts once, but i keep my hand on the tray. the person says, “sure, i think,” and i copy their tone. then i move the tray closer, but i keep my fingers on the edge. i wait for them to hear me again, then i put the spare parts back in the shared space."}]
